Who We Are: 
 Moneycorp powers global payments for corporates, institutions and high net worth individuals, combining worldwide reach with local expertise. With over 45 years of market experience, two banking licences and offices in 11 countries, our technology delivers 24/7 accessibility, while our people deliver award-winning service. In 2024, we supported $1tn+ of payment volume, reaching 190 countries in 130 currencies. Our 32k+ corporate clients benefit from our regulatory resilience with 63+ permissions globally, access to major payment rails, and our proprietary technology.
 Moneycorp is a place where energy, commitment, and collaboration are core to our values of shared success. We’re restless in our drive to surpass the expectations of our customers and unlock opportunities to support them at every stage of their journey. The foundation of our success is our people, and nurturing a culture of belonging for all our colleagues is central to our journey as a global business.
 Role Purpose: 
 This position sits within the IT Security Operations team and demands a confident and skilled individual who can rapidly understand complex systems and security challenges whilst balancing business priorities with security risks. This role would suit an early career Cybersecurity Engineer, or a more experienced Cybersecurity analyst looking for their next career step into an IT Security engineering role.
 This role will give plenty of opportunity to expand the candidates cyber security skillset whilst contributing to the development of IT Security strategies, policies and processes as well as the design and implementation (and continuous improvement) of commonly used security tools such as:
Threat prevention tools (email, CASB, web filters, identity protection etc.)
SIEM / SOAR tools.
VPNs / zero-trust clients.
IaaS & PaaS security tools.
Identity management tools.
Vulnerability management and patching tools.
 Role Responsibilities: 
Contribute to Moneycorp forward security architecture plans.
Platform / Product ownership and strategy for one or more specific security capabilities or security tools.
Contribute to the continuous improvement activities of the Security Operations and InfoSec teams by identifying areas for security improvement and assist in implementation of remedial actions and new systems as appropriate.
Provide security technical leadership for small to medium sized security initiatives.
Working closely with IT teams to promote and advocate the importance of effective security processes and policies into IT activities.
Provide training and mentoring to IT Security Operations security analysts.
 What We’re Looking For: 
 Essential:
3-4+ years experience in IT Security Engineering / Operations, working within complex IT environments.
Experience of working in complex project structures with geographically distributed team members and multiple deliverable dates.
Hands-on experience administering, engineering, or supporting SIEM and/or SOAR platforms (e.g. Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar, LogRhythm, or similar security monitoring and automation solutions).
Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) technologies, including Active Directory and/or Entra ID (Azure Active Directory), Conditional Access policies, authentication controls, access governance, and privileged access management.
Experience with one or more of the following security technologies:
Endpoint protection solutions such as Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
Endpoint, server management, and patch management platforms such as Microsoft Intune or equivalent.
Email security platforms such as Microsoft Defender for Office 365 or Proofpoint.
Secure Web Gateway, web filtering, or other network security technologies.
 Desirable
Experience with Zero Trust networking platforms such as Zscaler, iBoss, Cloudflare WARP, Akamai Guardicore, or similar technologies.
Experience with application security, vulnerability management, or code scanning tools such as Snyk.
Experience of supporting cloud security initiatives within Microsoft Azure environments.
Exposure to security automation, threat hunting, incident response, or security orchestration activities.
Experience of security hardening, security monitoring, and security compliance initiatives.
 One or more relevant cybersecurity certifications would also be desirable:
ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC)
CompTIA Security+
CompTIA CySA+
Microsoft SC-200
Microsoft SC-300
Microsoft SC-400
 Please note: This is a full-time, permanent and hybrid role based in Bucharest. However, we welcome applications from candidates across Romania, and for those located outside of Bucharest, we are open to a fully remote working arrangement. Candidates must have the legal right to work in Romania.
 Fostering a culture of belonging and inclusivity 
 We're committed to creating a workplace where every individual feels valued, respected, and included. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we actively cultivate an inclusive culture where diversity thrives, and we empower our colleagues to drive meaningful change within our organization through Employee Engagement initiatives and value champion networks.
 Like many of our peers, we recognize that fostering inclusivity is an ongoing journey, and we remain steadfast in our commitment to progress. By measuring our efforts through regular assessments and listening to the feedback of our employees, we strive to ensure that our initiatives are impactful and responsive to the evolving needs of our workforce.
